queries.sql: SELECT customer_type, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY customer_type
SELECT c.customer_type, sum(i.amount) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.created_at >= $1 GROUP BY c.customer_type
SELECT name, email, customer_type FROM customers WHERE email = $1
INSERT INTO invoices (customer_id, amount) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id
UPDATE invoices SET status = $1 WHERE id = $2
SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 day'
